tool_signatures.name: ai_llm_response
tool_signatures.description:
Gets what a specific LLM says about a query. Returns response_text, the model used, sources with URLs, fan_out_queries, and web_search_used. Each source carries a position — the order it was cited, from 1, counted after duplicate pages collapse. Supports chat_gpt, claude, gemini, perplexity.

WHETHER YOU GET SOURCES depends on whether the model searched the web. perplexity searches on every call, so its sources are populated and it needs no parameters. The other three answer from training data unless you set web_search: true, and on local business questions they otherwise do not search at all.

WEB SEARCH SUPPORT DIFFERS BY PLATFORM. claude takes web_search, force_web_search, search_country and search_city — the full set. chat_gpt takes all four except that GPT-5 models drop force_web_search. gemini takes web_search only: a search can be permitted but never compelled, and it cannot be geographically scoped. perplexity takes search_country only and cannot be switched off. Asking for something a platform does not support returns a 400 saying what it does support.

COST: 8 credits, or 20/40 if model pins a premium/frontier model. With web_search: true it is priced from the measured cost of searching — 24 for chat_gpt, 27 for gemini, 40 for claude. perplexity stays at 8 with search included.

ACCURACY WARNING: without web search a model may state confident, wrong facts about a local business, including that an open business has closed. When checking what a model says about a real business, use a platform that searches: perplexity, or any platform with web_search: true.
